I am a woman farming maize on my own plot here in the North East. I never went to school, so I do what my mother taught me and what I see my neighbors do. Cash is tight this season and fertilizer bags are expensive — I will try to buy one bag of NPK if the market has it when planting time comes, and spread it small-small across my maize, but I cannot buy urea on top of that. I keep goats and chickens so I will carry their droppings to the plot before the rains, like I did last year. I use the maize seed I kept from last harvest because the improved seed from the agro-dealer costs too much and the seller is far. I weed with my own hands and my daughter helps me; I do not have money for sprays or for hiring people, only at harvest maybe I call one person to help carry.
